🚇 One day on the Berlin U-Bahn — Thursday 22 October 2026.

3,820 trains on the nine lines U1 to U9, a network that opened its first line in 1902. Each dot is a scheduled train on the real track, in its line colour. Busiest moment: 128 trains on the move at 16:42.
